record.paper_title: Boundary and Defect CFT: Open Problems and Applications
record.original_question: What is the spacetime interpretation of the local gauge symmetry that appears in the bundle of quasi Riemann surfaces, such as the local SU(2)×SU(2) symmetry associated with the self-dual point of the two-dimensional Gaussian model?

evidence.quote: The local gauge symmetry in the bundle of quasi Riemann surfaces needs a space-time interpretation.

artifact.self_contained_problem: Consider the bundle of "quasi Riemann surfaces" associated with two-dimensional conformal field theories (in particular, the two-dimensional Gaussian / free-boson model at its self-dual radius), on whose total space there acts a local gauge symmetry — for instance, the local SU(2) × SU(2) symmetry that emerges at the self-dual point of the Gaussian model. Provide a spacetime interpretation of this local gauge symmetry: identify a geometric or physical structure on the underlying spacetime (or worldsheet/target-space construction) whose internal symmetries are realized precisely by this local gauge symmetry of the bundle of quasi Riemann surfaces, and explain in what sense that structure reproduces, in the Gaussian self-dual case, the local SU(2) × SU(2) action.
artifact.category_tag: Conformal field theory and gauge symmetry
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search for the specific notion of a "bundle of quasi Riemann surfaces" and its associated local gauge symmetry (including the SU(2)×SU(2) at the self-dual point of the Gaussian model) did not return any work providing a spacetime interpretation; the question is posed as an open problem awaiting clarification, with no published resolution found.

status_evidence.title: Search results for 'bundle of quasi Riemann surfaces' gauge symmetry
status_evidence.snippet: No published works were found that provide a spacetime interpretation of the local gauge symmetry on the bundle of quasi Riemann surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution to the spacetime interpretation question is available in the indexed literature.
